review_notes: Reduction audit of 5 src modules (801 lines). Two violations found: (1) Ticket dataclass in contracts.py is dead code — never imported by any source file, only TicketState and Pydantic models are consumed. (2) create_mcp_server() in contract_broker.py implements the FastMCP tool requirement but is only called from the integration test, never wired into orchestrator/main.py. Total 39 eliminable lines across 2 modules, all Q3 (unnecessary). No Q1 or Q2 violations found — stdlib/library coverage is appropriate; Pydantic for contract schemas, dataclass for internal state, asyncio.Event for lock-on-success are all correct choices.
